title: 🎹✨ JavaScript Virtual Piano - Play with Your Keyboard! ✨🎹
description:
This JavaScript Virtual Piano transforms your keyboard into a musical instrument! 🎶 Each key press plays a corresponding piano note, with visual feedback and note display. The elegant design features white and black keys, hover hints showing which keys to press, and a beautiful animated background.

Great for:

  • Learning basic piano notes 🎼

  • Understanding JavaScript event listeners 🖱️

  • Exploring CSS transitions and animations ✨

  • Having musical fun without a real piano! 😊
shortDescription: A sleek, interactive virtual piano that responds to your computer keyboard. Perfect for music lovers and coders alike!
